versions.content: In master and optionally primary OBD ECUs , the Dem shall incre- ment ECU global internal general denominator depending on the denominator DEM_IUMPR_GENERAL_OBDCOND , if available. Depending on the system definition the global general denominator (and therefore the DEM_IUMPR_GENERAL_OBDCOND ) may not be needed in some or even all primary ECUs . In such cases the DEM_IUMPR_- GENERAL_OBDCOND is never set, and the general denominator is stuck at 0 (and reporting of the InfoType $08 / $0B is disabled in the Dcm ).
